anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in close physical combat; one appears to strike or grapple the other in a dimly lit alleyway.

A large group of people (≥6) gathers aggressively in a confined outdoor space at night; some hold objects resembling weapons, and the group dynamics suggest coordinated violent unrest rather than isolated conflict.
A person is on the ground while multiple others surround and appear to assault them; one individual is crouched over the victim with arms raised, suggesting repeated striking or subduing.
A large group of people converges violently in a confined space; some are armed, others are being subdued or attacked, indicating collective violent unrest.
Multiple armed individuals aim and fire handguns; muzzle flash and smoke are visible in frames f13–f15, confirming active gunfire.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical combat, with one on top of the other in a struggle; visible grappling and forceful movement across frames f7–f10.
A person is being physically subdued or attacked by another individual in a dim, smoky room; the victim appears prone and helpless while the attacker leans over them with forceful motion.

Multiple silhouetted figures in a dark environment appear to be armed and moving aggressively; frames f13–f14 show at least three individuals holding long objects (likely weapons) in a confrontational posture, suggesting collective violent unrest.

A bright muzzle flash is visible in near-total darkness, consistent with a firearm discharge; appears in frame f15 as a sharp, elongated white burst against black background.; A bright muzzle flash is visible in darkness, consistent with a firearm discharge; the flash originates from a silhouetted figure holding a long object resembling a rifle.
A sudden, intense white flash erupts from an indoor location (likely near a television set), accompanied by smoke/dust expansion, indicating a violent detonation or electrical explosion.
A sudden, intense flash of white light erupts from the television set, accompanied by visible smoke and debris, consistent with a violent electrical explosion or implosion.
A second bright flash occurs, illuminating smoke and particles in the air, suggesting a secondary explosion or arcing event, possibly from damaged wiring or components after the first blast.
A person in striped clothing is seen lying on the ground while another individual repeatedly strikes or presses down on them in a dark indoor setting; the victim appears restrained or incapacitated.
A person in light clothing is seen restraining or pressing down on a dark, motionless figure on the ground in a dimly lit indoor setting; the posture suggests an attack on a helpless victim.

A group of silhouetted individuals gathers aggressively around a prone figure on a street at night; their postures and clustering suggest violent unrest or collective assault, with some figures appearing to move toward or over the body.; A large group of silhouetted individuals gathers aggressively on a street at night near a prone body; movement and clustering suggest collective violent unrest or confrontation, not a static crowd or peaceful assembly.
